content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met)** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier, or minimum-requirements covenant binding Sparkling:

- **§2 (Grant)** — the licence to us is expressly "non-transferable and **non-exclusive**"; it constrains where we may use the Software, not from whom we may buy.
- **§3 (Restrictions on Use)** — limited to copying, assignment/sublicensing, reverse engineering, scope of use and third-party protection precautions; no sourcing restriction.
- **§10 (Maintenance and Support)** and **§11 (Fees)** — maintenance is a renewable one-year service commitment by Garman with fee carve-backs for operator error, unpatched versions, modification and hardware failure; nothing prohibits us from engaging third-party maintenance or alternative suppliers.
- Remaining "exclusive" hits run in our favour or are unrelated: the escrow source-code licence to us is non-exclusive (p0115), §15 concerns exclusive remedies, and §20(h) is non-exclusive jurisdiction.
- **§19** is a mutual employee non-solicit, not exclusive dealing, and is not flagged here.

Because there is no exclusivity obligation at all, the fallback narrowing mechanics (defined product category, 12-month cap, automatic termination on service-level or delivery-date failure) are inapplicable.
